gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests how {@link DayOfYear} is obtained from the current clock and from non-ISO temporal objects.
ADDED i2: {@code DayOfYear.now()} must match the day-of-year of today's date in the default time-zone. Retried because the clock can roll over between the two "now" reads
ADDED i3: {@code DayOfYear.now(zone)} must match the day-of-year of today's date in the given time-zone. Retried for the same day-boundary reason as above.
ADDED i4: {@code DayOfYear.from} must accept a non-ISO temporal (a JapaneseDate), converting it to a LocalDate and yielding the same day-of-year.
